mapper.select: SELECT answer.* FROM trip_message answer INNER JOIN trip_message question ON question.id = answer.replyToId AND question.tripId = answer.tripId WHERE answer.tripId = #{tripId} AND answer.role = 'assistant' AND question.role = 'user' AND answer.isDelete = 0 AND question.isDelete = 0 AND answer.recallStatus = 'normal' AND question.recallStatus = 'normal' AND TRIM(answer.content) != '' AND TRIM(question.content) != '' ORDER BY answer.createTime DESC, answer.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
